scoring: Whole question/history/source/actual terminal; USABLE requires task usefulness, sendable wording and safety. No keyword, length or condition-count points. Functional adequacy is kept separate from voice acceptance.
limits: N1 per case/model; subjective unblinded primary, no independent or human acceptance. No detected unsafe eligible reply is an observation on these samples, not a safety guarantee or model qualification. Borderline style may be adjudicated by owner. Rejected drafts and verdict reasons have not been reviewed.
